flora: Mature Early Cypresses (tall, narrow-topped, with 'knees' or roots protruding from the mud)
Ferns clinging to the lower trunks
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasizing the 'knees' (pneumatophores) poking out of the clay mud; misty, humid coastal lagoon atmosphere.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view of a coastal lagoon edge. Several mature cypresses stand in thick, blue-grey clay mud. Their roots form 'knees' that stick up above the water line. The background shows a hazy, mottled red sandstone cliff.
visual_logic.ground: Saturated blue-grey clay mud with standing puddles and ripples of green-grey silt.
visual_logic.lighting: Soft, humid, overcast light that makes the mottled colors of the Wealden clay stand out without harsh shadows.
